summary: Enhance your team's skills with our Service Quality and Customer Satisfaction Training Course. Boost customer loyalty and improve service excellence today!
lede: Assessing service quality means comparing customer expectations with service performance and identifying where processes need improvement. This course is for customer experience managers, service quality analysts, and contact centre supervisors who work to improve customer-facing processes; it covers satisfaction measurement, journey mapping, root-cause analysis, complaint-resolution workflow design, and KPI reporting.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who measure, manage, improve, or govern customer-facing service processes. It is appropriate for foundation to intermediate learners who need a practical service quality framework rather than advanced statistical or software engineering training.
prerequisites: You need basic experience in customer-facing operations, service supervision, quality monitoring, customer support, or process improvement. No coding or programming is required. You should bring a current service challenge, sample feedback themes, or an anonymized process example for selected exercises.
